description: Unit test for the JacksonCborFactory class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json.cbor package, testing serialization and deserialization of JSON values with CBOR encoding using Jackson library.

classes.name: JacksonCborFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing CBOR serialization/deserialization functionality of JacksonCborFactory.

methods.name: testValue_STRINGS
methods.description: Provides various JSON string examples as test data for the parameterized tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes test data, converting JSON strings to JsonValue objects and serialize them with Jackson for testing.

methods.name: readFromByteArrayWithoutOffset
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a byte array without an offset.

methods.name: readFromByteArrayWithOffset
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a byte array with an offset and length.

methods.name: readFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: readFromByteBufferWithInaccessibleArray
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonValue from a read-only ByteBuffer, ensuring no direct array access.

methods.name: toBytebufferWorks
methods.description: Verifies that converting a JsonValue to ByteBuffer and then to hex string matches expected serialization.

methods.name: writeToByteBufferWorks
methods.description: Tests writing a JsonValue into an allocated ByteBuffer and verifies correctness.
